# Enable 4 sig (hold)

This is Basic Block Catalog type `497` (`Enable 4 sig _hold`). It implements logical or event-driven signal behaviour.

<!-- veragrid-block-introduction:start -->
**Enable 4 sig (hold)** belongs to the hybrid/event layer of a dynamic model. It selects, stores, delays, or switches signals according to conditions, so its result depends on discrete mode or accepted simulation history in addition to the instantaneous continuous variables.

## Typical use

- Use it for protection, enable/disable sequences, sampled control, reset logic, and mode transfer.
- Define initial mode and boundary behavior explicitly to avoid unintended event chattering.
<!-- veragrid-block-introduction:end -->

## Behaviour

- Library location: `Native / Logic and Events / Timers and Enables`.
- Inputs: 5.
- Outputs: 4.
- Declared states: 0.
- Configurable parameters: 0.
- The imported definition is fully supported by the Dynamic Editor catalogue.

## Characteristic equations

$$
0 = (yo1 - Enable 4 sig _{hold\_yi1\_register})
$$

$$
0 = (yo2 - Enable 4 sig _{hold\_yi2\_register})
$$

$$
0 = (yo3 - Enable 4 sig _{hold\_yi3\_register})
$$

$$
0 = (yo4 - Enable 4 sig _{hold\_yi4\_register})
$$

$$
0 = (Enable 4 sig _{hold\_yi1\_register} - (proc_{select\_1} \cdot yi1 + (1 - proc_{select\_1}) \cdot proc_{lastvalue\_0}))
$$

$$
0 = (Enable 4 sig _{hold\_yi2\_register} - (proc_{select\_3} \cdot yi2 + (1 - proc_{select\_3}) \cdot proc_{lastvalue\_2}))
$$

$$
0 = (Enable 4 sig _{hold\_yi3\_register} - (proc_{select\_5} \cdot yi3 + (1 - proc_{select\_5}) \cdot proc_{lastvalue\_4}))
$$

$$
0 = (Enable 4 sig _{hold\_yi4\_register} - (proc_{select\_7} \cdot yi4 + (1 - proc_{select\_7}) \cdot proc_{lastvalue\_6}))
$$

$$
Enable 4 sig _{hold\_yi1\_register}(t_0) = yi1
$$

$$
Enable 4 sig _{hold\_yi2\_register}(t_0) = yi2
$$

$$
Enable 4 sig _{hold\_yi3\_register}(t_0) = yi3
$$

$$
Enable 4 sig _{hold\_yi4\_register}(t_0) = yi4
$$

## Editing notes

Use General options for numeric parameter values and the DAE tab for symbolic variables and equations. Changing an Output flag only controls whether a variable is exported; it does not remove the variable from the model.
